plan.title: Scholarship Applicant Overview
plan.subtitle: A snapshot of scholarship applications by status, marks, and location.

panels.title: Total Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applications by Status
panels.sql: SELECT Status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Average Marks by Category
panels.sql: SELECT Category, AVG(Marks %) AS avg_marks FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Talukas
panels.sql: SELECT Taluka, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Family Income Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT Family Income, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides an overview of scholarship applications. The total number of applications is {{p1}}.  {{p2}} shows the distribution of applications across different statuses.  {{p3}} displays the average marks for each category, offering insights into academic performance.  {{p4}} highlights the top 10 talukas with the most applications, indicating geographical distribution.  {{p5}} illustrates the distribution of family incomes among applicants.
